status: captured (single page), judged by 2 combined AI jurors and the owner

business.what: Regulatory and legal advisory for fintech and crypto companies (PSP licences under PSD2, MiCA, token legal opinions).
business.action_that_pays: Send a Message / Book a Call / Telegram (no form on the page)

claims.claim: Hero motion gives a strong message
claims.evidence: Rive animation turns industry keycaps (Payments, Gaming, Fintech, Crypto) into the woven Axis logo: on concept, but abstract, wordless and below a generic headline; the fold never says legal, licensing or MiCA.
Dark UI mockups of the clients' products (crypto prices, AI chat, payment QR, investment balance), not of Axis's own legal service.

claims.claim: There is motion that depicts chat
claims.verdict: true, and it is the most useful motion
claims.evidence: In 'How we work' a client-Axis chat, a handwritten strategy note with named cursors and a redlined token-warrant document build on scroll: the work itself shown as it happens. Judged from stills.

entries.motion: Carries the message: hero keycaps→logo, chat, strategy note, redlined document. Decoration: card and logo loops, gradient text reveals. Cost: 56 endless loops (10 with text) with no pause, 10 elements moving under reduced motion, 4.9 fps while scrolling with scripts blocking 95% (software rendering: relative, but the heaviest page in the library); 8 texts never shown on the phone.
library_candidates: Motion that shows the work being done (chat, annotated note, redlined document) to explain a service that has no product
A hero animation that turns the sectors served into the brand mark
Accent words in an italic display serif against a neutral sans: one typographic device across every heading
Product mockups of the client's own industries on dark cards
avoid: 56 loops with no pause and motion that ignores reduced motion; a page this heavy
A hero that is only a slogan while the licences and proof ($1B+, 10+ jurisdictions) wait at 57-75% of the page
Typos ('Intellligence'), a subheading used twice, an unnamed testimonial; 14 font sizes

owner_taste_signal: Largest gap on craft (owner 9, AI 4): the owner judges motion by the message it carries; the jurors also count its cost (performance, pause, reduced motion). Both are kept: the skill's rule becomes 'motion that carries the message, with a pause control, a reduced-motion version and a performance budget'.
